Title: General availability: Azure Log Analytics UI updates May 2021

Body.Content:
New Experience for Custom Logs:

Azure Log Analytics custom logs get an updated experience. You can now control and manage your custom table and custom fields from a new dedicated blade, offering a new UI that enhances your custom logs experince.

Learn more about the new custom logs experience in Log Analytics.

Pinned Azure Dashboard part filter integration:

Log Analytics pinned parts to Azure dashboard now support filter integration.  Use the dashboard filter to interact with the data in your pinned Log Analytics dashboard parts and gain faster insights.

Learn more about the new filtering capabilities in Azure Dashboards.
